tagline: A walkable river city of Georgian squares, cobbled lanes and pub music sessions, with Europe's tech headquarters lining its docks.

events.name: St Patrick's Festival
events.desc: Several days of music, talks and street events, culminating in the parade through the city centre on St Patrick's Day itself.

events.name: Bloomsday
events.desc: Readings, walks and Edwardian costume tracing the route of James Joyce's Ulysses, which is set on 16 June 1904.

events.name: Dublin Fringe and Dublin Theatre Festival
events.desc: Back-to-back festivals of new, experimental and international theatre in venues across the city.

events.name: Dublin Marathon
events.desc: A mass-participation marathon through the city's streets and parks, starting and finishing in the centre.
